description:
BOREAL SUN is a collaboration between vocalist Liselotte Östblom
and producer/multi-instrumentalist Matt Roberts. Formed in
London, UK, BOREAL SUN showcases the very best talent of the
city’s thriving jazz, groove and independent music scenes. Their
debut EP ‘Dawn’ features contributions from bassist/producer Robin Mullarkey (Brotherly, Jacob Collier), saxophonist Emma Rawicz, percussionist Yahael Camara Onono (Balimaya Project), drummer Josh Blackmore (Troyka, SiZE) and many more.

The project combines syncopated grooves, sweeping
orchestrations, uplifting vocal hooks, powerful lyrical themes and
explorative improvisations. The result is a rich, captivating sonic
landscape that speaks to the breadth of influences that have
informed the duo. Influences that range from the 1970’s fusion
excursions of Herbie Hancock and Wayne Shorter, to London’s Broken Beat and Acid Jazz movements of the 1990’s. But make
no mistake, BOREAL SUN present an unmistakably contemporary
sound, with a unique scope and depth of musicality.
